blocks.html: Beyond the grid itself, a GRG can carry map references and markers. Open Edit GRG > Edit GRG Components and expand each item to add it.

slides.title: Add a crosshair
slides.html: Crosshair places an aiming cross on the grid. Reposition it with Move Crosshair, set its color and opacity, and adjust the size. Toggle it with the Show Crosshair checkbox.

slides.title: Add an info box
slides.html: InfoBox shows a labelled box on the grid. Edit the Title, Location, Date and Classification text and their colors; set the Theme, Style, Placement and Text Alignment. Toggle it with the Show Info Box checkbox.

slides.title: Add a scale bar
slides.html: ScaleBar adds a scale showing either cell range or map range. The cell-range value defaults to the Edit Grid spacing; adjust the map-range size and segment values to taste. Toggle it with the Show Scale Bar checkbox.

slides.title: Add a compass
slides.html: Compass adds a north reference. Pick the style (Full or True + Mag), its position and declination; with True + Mag you can also set the color. Toggle it with the Show Compass checkbox.

slides.title: Add markers with Point Dropper
slides.html:
Select Open Point Dropper to place markers on the grid — choose a marker type and tap a position; use the arrows for more types.

  • Placed markers appear under Recently Added, where they can be sent, edited or deleted.
  • Use Edit Grid Markers > Name Markers to auto-rename spot markers by the quadrant they fall in.

slides.title: Import points from a file
slides.html:
Import markers from a .csv or .xlsx with Import Points.

  • Name, Prefix and Location (Lat/Long or MGRS) columns are required; Elevation, Remarks, Color and Type are optional.
  • If a column doesn't match, the Assign Columns window lets you map each column — or change a marker's type — before importing.
